results.test: Six independent services respond to health
Register returns public user; duplicate email rejected
Wrong password rejected
Login and session introspection
Catalog contracts and unknown product
CORS preflight authorizes Vite
Negative, zero and fractional quantities rejected
Duplicate lines are aggregated before availability check
Public callers cannot mutate stock or forge internal actions
All-or-nothing stock reservation on shortage
Order uses server catalog price and reserves stock
Order cannot be paid via customer status PATCH
Unpaid order cannot create shipment
Payment succeeds and order becomes PAID
Payment retry returns same record without double charge
Shipment creation is idempotent and uses order address
Cancellation refunds simulation, restores stock exactly once and cancels shipment
Shipping progression enforces sequence and synchronizes order
User ownership enforced across orders, payments and shipments
Concurrent reservations cannot oversell
Concurrent idempotency key creates one order
Auth passwords are salted hashes, sessions are token hashes
Service restart preserves persisted order and stock
Catalog outage produces 503 without changing stock
Logout revokes session
